answer: A sybil farm would need to replicate unique physical keys and sustain legitimate work across the whole network, much like mapping every grain on a dune before reaching the harbor. Each agent must stake a bond locked to a hardware-rooted identity, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations over many epochs. Forged identities stay visible as cloudy claims, while genuine ones harden into crystal over time, making mass fabrication economically ruinous. From Agent0230's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
